headline: Higher trial spending widens the quarterly loss
summary_short: SELLAS Life Sciences reported a Q2 2026 net loss of $9.6 million, up from $6.6 million a year ago, driven by higher R&D and G&A spend, while ending the quarter with $138.3 million in cash.
summary_long: Net loss widened 45.5% y/y to $9.6M as R&D expense rose 61.5% to $6.3M on manufacturing, clinical, and regulatory-consulting costs ahead of a potential BLA submission, and G&A rose 46.7% to $4.4M on higher professional fees and stock-based compensation. Loss per share narrowed to $0.05 from $0.07 despite the wider dollar loss, implying a materially larger share count. The company ended the quarter with $138.3M in cash. Pipeline progress: the Phase 3 REGAL trial of GPS in AML is approaching its pre-specified 80th event ahead of final efficacy analysis, and the Phase 2 trial of SLS009 in newly diagnosed AML has enrolled 28 patients with topline data expected in Q4 2026. No formal cash-runway guidance was given.
